newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, after earlier gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, after earlier gains.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Tuesday, as the yen's weaker tone against the dollar triggered buying by local investors, particularly in nearby months, traders said.
Prices ranged from 200 yen lower to 70 yen higher, with the benchmark November 1997 contract down 70 yen at 14,010 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 50,872 lots.

Active buying by individual investors emerged in the morning session, on price gains in the Chicago market overnight and the yen's weaker tone, the traders said. But distant contracts fell back by late afternoon, they said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading corn system was being traded at $2.74-1/2 per bushel at 0915 GMT, against $2.75-1/4 at Tuesday's close.
The spot November of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.02-3/4 at 0915 GMT, against $7.02-1/4 at Tuesday's close.
